information: ### In addition to official WCA events, this competition will feature many extra unofficial events for competitors to compete in. * 15 Puzzle * 2x2x3 Cube (Tower Cube) * 3x3x3 Team-Blind * 3x3x3 Assembly * Corner Helicopter 2x2 * Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO) * Ivy Cube * Mirror Blocks * Magic * Master Magic * Cap on Pen ### More details, including rules and the sign-up link, can be found on the [Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OHWeekendofMadness2026#65419-unofficial-events) tab.
